dependencies.repair: Personal AIOmetadata or explicit Xperience adapter configuration, identity/displayed fields and injected TMDB key. Xperience needs declared order and unique TVDB episode evidence for TVDB input; src/input-metadata.js. Compare scripts/probe_xperience.py and its private workflow without exposing raw config. AIO defaults and AniBridge/ani.zip policies remain independent. For switching, check inputMetadataAdapter and the selected aiometadataSavedManifestUrl/xperienceManifestUrl slot. Legacy aiometadataManifestUrl is read only before either dedicated key is saved; never query inactive/legacy slots to conceal an empty selection.

Check data/current.json, selected immutable revision/index/hash and directional AniBridge v3 range; scripts/update_en_mappings.py and src/sources-en/mapping-data.js. Daily workflow publishes data only to Preview after gates. Delivery/schema failure may use compiled baseline; valid missing rules/conflicts cannot retry older data. No invented offsets. Missing/unsupported/ambiguous maps are silent in ordinary results; use settings diagnostic. Only known contradictions show optional warnings.

ani.zip is veto-only. Compare supplied exact AIO TVDB episode ID and known ani.zip identities/positions/comparable dates; matching explicit episode IDs outrank alternate labels/dates. Missing/partial/unavailable ani.zip data must not block playback. Never guess past a known contradiction; src/sources-en/mapping.js.
Ani.pm bootstrap identity and per-episode package flags; upstream missing uploads can be valid.

Use diagnostic stage/status to separate bootstrap denial from Settlar access after mapping. Check first-party JSON headers and bounded embed-document/applicable-cookie recovery in src/sources-en/native.js. Keep recovery/persistent-denial fixtures and live controls. Historical beta.5 denials were followed by successful sessions; do not assume those old errors persist. A full User-Agent is not browser TLS impersonation. No remote script/challenge execution or invented proxy.

dependencies.symptom: EN_PLAYLIST_UNREADABLE, channel HTTP failure or playback failure
dependencies.repair: Original signed master, CDN headers, variants/audio groups/segments and captions; src/sources-en/playlist.js. Do not rewrite grants or keep stale streams. For extensionless Settlar masters, require output type=hls as well as format=m3u8; Mobile ignores format. verify_sources_en.py must report player_contract_ok as well as actual bounded media/caption availability. Master200 does not prove native playback.

dependencies.symptom: Mapped episode yields zero accepted streams
dependencies.repair: Inspect actual referenced HLS groups and full FR/EN captions. MULTI needs multiple verified preferred audio languages; Standard singles show selected SUB/DUB, Beta singles use original/dub audio. Keep original/FR/EN and preferred subtitle summary below quality; retain every master track. Original-only without full FR/EN captions may correctly produce no result.

dependencies.symptom: Beta missing, EN_BETA_* or video plays without selectable audio
dependencies.repair: Independent sources-en-anipm-beta entry needs its own AIOmetadata settings. config/sources-en.json owns betaServerPath/betaMediaPath. Check exact mapped AniList episode membership, fresh copy grant and Settlar session, referenced audio groups and preferred captions. Run Beta inventory cases including alternate-audio probes on TV/Mobile fixtures; never rewrite the signed master or treat catalogue languages as actual playlist proof. Standard Sub/Dub must not request or wait for Beta.
